import numpy as np
import numpy.linalg as la
def diagonalize(A):
    # A: nxn matrix
    m, n = np.shape(A)
    if (m != n):
      return None

    evals, evecs = la.eig(A) # eigenvectors as columns
    if (la.matrix_rank(evecs) != n):
      return None

    D = np.diag(evals)
    X = evecs
    return (D, X)
